about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: The story of a Brazilian dev with global ambitions.
about.bio_1: I started coding in 2022 almost by accident — I needed websites for dropshipping stores and decided to learn how to build them myself. What was a practical solution became an obsession. Within months, I was rebuilding everything I'd learned from scratch, understanding every line of code.
about.bio_2: In 2023, I took that knowledge to Construtora Pacaembu, where I built internal lead management systems, high-conversion landing pages, and managed paid traffic campaigns. It was my first encounter with technology at real scale — where a bug isn't just a technical problem, it's financial loss.
about.bio_3: In 2024, I made the full switch to full-stack development. I co-founded The Kaden — a WhatsApp automation SaaS for aesthetic clinics and hair salons —, built CONDOR (a local AI assistant focused on privacy), and founded Null Forge as a social impact initiative in technology.
about.bio_4: Today I work at Loog.ai, a Brazilian AI-first logistics platform, where I apply everything I've learned at the frontline of innovation. My ambition has no geographic limits: I want to study at Harvard, MIT, or Oxford, and prove that world-class tech can be born in Brazil.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about my work and collaborations.
faq.a1: Full-stack development (Next.js, Node.js, React), product consulting, MVP development, WhatsApp automation, and SaaS systems. I also accept social impact projects through Null Forge.
faq.q2: Are you open to remote work opportunities outside Brazil?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely. I have conversational English and am actively seeking international exposure. I dream of studying and working globally — serious opportunities are always welcome.
faq.q3: Do you work as a freelancer or only on your own projects?
faq.a3: Both. I have my own projects (The Kaden, CONDOR, Null Forge) and I'm open to freelance contracts or remote employment for projects that challenge me.
faq.q4: How long does it take to build a project like The Kaden?
faq.a4: The Kaden was built in approximately 4 months from idea to functional MVP in production. Time varies enormously based on scope, stack, and team size.
faq.q5: What stack do you recommend for SaaS today?
faq.a5: For most SaaS: Next.js (App Router) + Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage) + Stripe + Vercel. Fast, scalable, and great DX. I adapt the recommendation for specific cases.
faq.q6: Do you accept partnerships or co-founding?
faq.a6: Depending on the project and alignment with the mission, yes. I need to believe in the problem and the team. If you have a genuinely promising idea, tell me — I might be interested.
faq.a7: Occasionally, through Null Forge. If you're starting in tech and want guidance, send me a message explaining where you are in your journey. I don't promise availability, but I read everything.
faq.a8: In 2022, I needed websites for dropshipping stores and didn't want to pay an agency. I learned HTML/CSS/JS from scratch. I got bitten by the code bug and never stopped.
faq.q9: Can I use CONDOR, Null Forge, or The Kaden?
faq.a9: The Kaden: visit thekaden.com.br for plan information. CONDOR: project in development, no public release yet. Null Forge: reach out if you're a school or educational organization interested in partnership.
faq.q10: How can I reach you fastest?
faq.a10: Email (kauadsouza@gmail.com) or Instagram (@kauaartx) are the fastest channels. LinkedIn is more formal. I usually reply within 24h on weekdays.
